Steps.1: Check on schematic and board that the RS485 transceiver have implemented a resistor termination technic.
Steps.2: Check the BOM and verify the value of each resistor.
Steps.4: Configure the multimeter as ohmmeter. Setup the 4-wire mode on it and Auto-Range.
Steps.5: Connect the multimeter leads to the specified pins.
Steps.6: Check the resistance between these pins is 120 ohms.
